text_sanskrit: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः । पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः ॥ १-१५ ॥
itrans: pA~nchajanya.n hR^iShIkesho devadatta.n dhana~njayaH . pauNDra.n dadhmau mahAsha~NkhaM bhImakarmA vR^ikodaraH .. 1-15 ..
translation: Hrishikesa (the ruler of the senses) blew his Panchajanya and Dhananjaya his Devadatta; Vrikodara (Bhima) of terrible deeds blew his mighty conch Poundra.
